bundle.shortDescription: A simple, modern desktop app for yt-dlp
bundle.longDescription: Download videos and playlists from YouTube and thousands of other sites as MP4, MKV, WebM, MP3, M4A or Opus. A friendly desktop interface for yt-dlp with a download queue, quality picker and automatic tool updates.
